# Release membership report (generated by R/00b_release_inputs.R)

Rules: A33 population (docs/amendment_2026-09-06.md), A24 strict comparison, A25 measurement rule as approved on 10 September 2026 (A36). Membership is derived mechanically from data/review/population_eligibility.csv, data/review/release_construct_review.csv and the release-layer ledger rows.

## Release-layer corrections applied

- C15 CRAIG_2014 proportion `events`: 41 to 36 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C16 CRAIG_2014 proportion `outcome_definition`: Paid job at or above minimum wage in a mainstream setting at 12-month follow-up to In open (paid, mainstream) employment on the day of the 12-month interview (26 of 68 intervention plus 10 of 66 control) (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C17 ABDELBAKI_2013 proportion `events`: 55 to 40 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C18 ABDELBAKI_2013 proportion `n_assessed`: 97 to 91 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C19 ABDELBAKI_2013 proportion `outcome_definition`: Paid employment /occupation at 12 months to Full-time or part-time employment at 12 months (Figure 2); education and homemaking excluded (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C20 ERICKSON_2021 trial_binary `events_intervention`: 34 to 30 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C21 ERICKSON_2021 trial_binary `n_intervention`: 47 to 50 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C22 ERICKSON_2021 trial_binary `events_control`: 25 to 30 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C23 ERICKSON_2021 trial_binary `n_control`: 50 to 52 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C24 ERICKSON_2021 trial_binary `timepoint_months`: 12 to 6 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C25 ERICKSON_2021 trial_binary `outcome_definition`: Any competitive paid work during the 6_12 month follow-up period to Any competitive paid work during the 0_6 month follow-up period (intake to 6-month follow-up) (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C26 MAJOR_2010 proportion `outcome_definition`: Gained or returned to competitive employment at any point during the 12-month follow-up period to In competitive employment at any time during the 12-month follow-up (includes the 16 participants competitively employed at baseline who remained so) (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C27 TURNER_2019 proportion `notes`: Follow-up was a mean of 19 months (range 2 to 44), not a fixed 18 months to Variable follow-up: one interview per participant at a mean of 18 months (SD 12; range 2 to 44), so part of the sample was assessed outside the 6 to 24 month window; excluded from the fixed-window sets and reported in the variable-follow-up analysis only (A36). The historical C11 note gives the mean as 19; the Results state 18 (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C28 VANDUIN_2021 proportion `outcome_basis`: point to period (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
- C29 VANDUIN_2021 proportion `outcome_definition`: In competitive employment at 18-month follow-up to In competitive employment at any time during the six months before the 18-month assessment (months 12 to 18) (A36, RT, 10 Sep 2026)
